notes: In this episode of Two White Guys and a Wheelchair, hosts Erik and Raiden sit down with Bryan Lawrence and Mason Sheppard, the founders of 822 Entertainment, a business that specializes in buying, selling, and moving pool tables in Calgary, Alberta. Bryan is a dental school candidate (and Lasik surgery survivor) and Mason is a former tech industry recruiter, but they share a passion for pool tables and decided to turn it into a business venture. In this interview, they share their journey of starting and growing their business, including the challenges they faced and the lessons they learned along the way. As friends of Erik and Raiden, Bryan and Mason also discuss their friendship, how it has influenced their business partnership, and how they were able to complete a trek up the West Coast Trail. They talk about their shared values and interests, how they complement each other's skills and strengths, and what it's like to get shot with BBs. Finally, Bryan and Mason share their outlook on the future of their business, as well as the pool table industry in Calgary. They discuss the trends they see in the market, and their plans for expanding their services to offer more to their customers. Join Erik and Raiden as they chat with Bryan and Mason about their unique business and the friendship that inspired it.
